article:
Five sentences have been removed from the text below. For each question, choose the correct answer. There are three extra sentences which you do not need to use.
Steve Dalway's cycle ride
Steve Dalway has recently completed an amazing bike ride between the US cities of Los Angeles and Boston, a distance of nearly 5,500 km. He and ten other cyclists took part in a trip organised by a company that provided a mechanic, planned the accommodation and route, and carried the cyclists' bags. 16______ Even with these, the ride involved a huge amount of effort.
Steve had already completed another long cycle ride in Europe. 17______ For example, he knew that on any ride, eating properly is important. When you don't eat enough, your ability to recover after hard exercise is reduced. For this reason, he always made sure he had a large breakfast before setting off every morning. 18______ The sight of the hotel at the end of the day was still very welcome, however!
One of the toughest times for the riders in the US was when the route climbed high into the Rocky Mountains. By the end of that part of the ride, Steve had climbed an amazing 28,000 m in total. 19______ An early section of the ride, for instance, took the group of cyclists through the Mojave desert, where the high temperatures made them feel as if they were in an oven. In the desert, Steve had to drink four litres of liquid every 40 km in order to keep going.
The cyclists used paper maps and had electronic devices to record the distances they travelled. So that everyone knew what they'd be facing the next day, a big map was displayed every evening in the hotel where the group were staying. 20______ At first the cyclists were disappointed when the black line drawn on the map by the organisers only moved forward by small amounts, despite all the day's work. At the end of the ride, however, they felt very proud of what they'd achieved.

sentences.label: A
sentences.text: He therefore had an idea of what to expect on this one.

sentences.label: B
sentences.text: It also allowed them to see the progress they had made.

sentences.label: C
sentences.text: He was surprised that he had gone so fast.

sentences.label: D
sentences.text: Doing that gave him the energy he needed to keep going.

sentences.label: E
sentences.text: It also arranged stops every 50 km for snacks and drinks.

sentences.label: F
sentences.text: This ride would be 1,000 km longer.

sentences.label: G
sentences.text: As a result, Steve's family knew how he was feeling each day.

explanations.16: 公司提供机械师、规划路线等，E选项“It also arranged stops every 50 km for snacks and drinks.”（还安排每50公里休息点）补充服务细节，与“provided a mechanic, planned accommodation”并列。
explanations.17: Steve曾完成欧洲骑行，A选项“He therefore had an idea of what to expect on this one.”（因此对此次骑行有预期）衔接前文经验，与“knew that on any ride, eating properly is important”形成因果。
explanations.18: Steve早餐吃得多，D选项“Doing that gave him the energy he needed to keep going.”（这为他提供能量）解释早餐的作用，与“huge breakfast before setting off”呼应。
explanations.19: 落基山脉是挑战，H选项“There were other challenges, too.”（还有其他挑战）引出沙漠高温，构成并列挑战，逻辑连贯。
explanations.20: 每晚展示地图，B选项“It also allowed them to see the progress they had made.”（让他们看到进展）说明地图的作用，与“black line moved forward by small amounts”呼应。
